newsitem.title: USA: Scios suspends development of Auriculin.
newsitem.headline: Scios suspends development of Auriculin.

text.p: Scios Inc said it suspended development of AURICULIN anaritide based on the results of interim analysis of data from its Phase III study in oliguric acute renal failure.
The study was suspended due to the low probability that a positive outcome could be obtained with respect to its primary clinical endpoint, dialysis-free survival.
Despite this development, we remain optimistic about the viability of other products in our pipeline, the company said.
